title: Compass prospecting audit + outreach jotter
content:
Context:
- Compass (mid-market fintech platform) — evaluating embedded LLM for customer support automation and knowledge search.
- Goal: secure a pilot with their Product/Platform team (SaaS product; multi-tenant; sensitive PII in transcripts). Focus: reduce CS ticket deflection and speed up triage.
- Why now: Compass announced growth initiative for self-serve tools; hiring in Platform and Data infra.

Quick account map (notes to self):
- Primary technical DM: Rajiv Malhotra, Director of Platform (linkedin says infra + SRE background).
- Product sponsor: Elena Ruiz, Head of Customer Experience (owns CS metrics).
- Legal/compliance: Martha Li, Counsel (privacy + PCI concerns).
- Procurement: not engaged yet — likely mid-deal for pilot sizes < $50k so OK to skip early.

Value props to test:
- 1) Hosted API with configurable private deployment (VPC option) — reduce lift vs self-hosting.
- 2) Dedicated latency and SLOs for real-time agent use-cases (chat UI).
- 3) Cost predictability via Reserved pools for peak support windows.

Personalized outreach snippets (use A/B test):
Subject A: Quick pilot to cut CS triage time by 30%?
Subject B: Rajiv — VPC option for LLM pilots (low lift, privacy-first)
Email body (short):
Hi {firstName},
Saw Compass's note about improving self-serve in the product roadmap — curious if you'd be open to a 30-min pilot discussion. We help platform teams run LLM inference with VPC controls, predictable latency, and a small staged pilot that integrates with existing transcript pipelines. Could I book 20-30m next week to sketch out a pilot?
Thanks,
Maya

Call script bullets (first intro):
- 2 min: quick intros + context (we know product initiative).
- 3 min: confirm current stack (where transcripts live, tooling for routing).
- 5 min: pain and metrics (CS ticket volume, triage time SLAs).
- 7 min: propose pilot: ingest last 30 days of transcripts (anonymized), run evals on deflection and suggested reply quality, measure latency under demo traffic.
- 3 min: next steps (tech/PII guardrails + legal touchpoints).

Anticipated objections & rebuttals (rapid-fire):
- "We can't send PII to a hosted provider." -> "We offer VPC/private control plane + customer-managed KMS, can run in their cloud or on-prem for pilot. We can share SOC2 + audit artifacts and a narrow DPA/POC contract."
- "Latency for live chat is too high." -> "We can scope to a smaller model variant + dedicated pool; Redwood has latency profiles for interactive SLOs — show benchmark table in next deck."
- "We already built a homegrown system." -> "Totally common — we can run a side-by-side: same prompts/metrics, show cost/ops delta after 2 weeks. Our goal is to surface operational burden savings not just model perf."
- "Pricing is a blocker." -> "Offer pilot pricing: 6-week pilot, capped spend, optional conversion credits if they buy dedicated capacity."

Pilot design (proposal sketch):
- Duration: 6 weeks (2 weeks ingestion + wireup, 2 weeks eval, 2 weeks tuning + final results)
- Success metrics: 20%+ automated deflection OR 30% improvement in median triage time; latency p95 < 250ms for interactive queries
- Data security: ingest via S3 transfer + ephemeral keys OR direct VPC peering; default masking pipeline for PII during pilot
- Deliverables: weekly dashboards, eval notebook (precision/recall of suggested replies), post-pilot ops checklist for production roll

Internal asks (what I need):
- Demo env: request a sandbox with VPC-enabled runtime from infra (ticket RED-412) — assign to Liam for setup.
- Legal: templated DPA for pilot + notes on data retention (ping Martha for early alignment).
- One-pager: quick deck mapping Compass stack -> Redwood integration (Sofia to draft).

Open questions / research items:
- Tech stack signal: does Compass use Segment/Amplitude? (helps with tracking events for evaluation).
- Where do they store transcripts? S3, BigQuery, or internal DB? Need to confirm in discovery call.
- Who signs pilot contract? VP of Product or Procurement? Ask Elena in discovery.

Follow-up cadence (sequence):
1) Cold email (short)
2) Follow-up 3 days — include 1 pager + one-sentence pilot offer
3) LinkedIn connect + quick nudge 4 days after follow-up
4) Final outbound week later with specific calendar slots

Measurement + tracking (how we'll report):
- Create a Linear ticket per outreach sequence (status, replies, meeting date) — tag RED-growth.
- Track conversion KPI: reply rate, meeting booked, pilot signed, pilot -> paid conversion rate.

Notes to self / style guide for personalization:
- Always reference a concrete product signal from the blog/press (e.g., "self-serve initiative Jan 2025").
- Use specific metric hooks: current CS SLA numbers if mentioned; else ask for them in call.
- Keep pilot friction low: highlight limited data scope, capped spend, clear exit criteria.

Next steps (this week):
- Draft outreach A/B templates and upload to Shared Outreach folder — due Thu EOD.
- Ping Liam to spin up sandbox with VPC and sample transcripts (block 2 dev hours).
- Book 30-min discovery with Rajiv + Elena (aim for week of 3/22).

Rough meeting prep checklist (for call):
- Bring benchmark slide: latency/throughput for small model + dedicated pool
- Pilot timeline visual (Gantt)
- One-pager on security controls and DPA highlights
- List of example prompts + obfuscated transcript snippets to discuss

Random scratch ideas (maybe useful):
- Offer a "compass-branded" demo: UI with their logo and example canned replies — helps PM buy-in.
- Data residency quick test: ask if they want an on-prem initial run; if so, propose limited on-prem POC for compliance review (longer lead time).

End of jotter — retain as living doc for thread. Will iterate after first outreach batch results.

-- Maya
